metaDescription: See how HappyDate helps you remember important people, dates and moments, and discover new ways of caring that are coming next.

hero.title: More ways to be there.
hero.description: HappyDate begins with remembering what matters. Over time, new ways to support, surprise and stay close to the people who matter will appear here.

current.title: Your space for caring about important people
current.description: Keep the people, dates, memories, interests and small details that are easy to lose in everyday life.

future.title: New ways to care
future.description: Some ideas are already in development. They will appear gradually after we verify their quality, safety and real value for users.

listen.title: Listen to me
listen.lead: Sometimes you do not need advice. You just need someone to listen.
listen.description: A space to talk things out, sort through your thoughts or simply feel heard.

groupMessage.title: Group message
groupMessage.description: Collect messages, wishes or short videos from friends and family into one special surprise.

sharedGift.title: Shared gift
sharedGift.lead: When many people create one gift together.
sharedGift.description: HappyDate will help organise a shared gesture, surprise or contribution without endless group chats.

kindness.title: Give some good
kindness.lead: Doing something kind can be a gift too.
kindness.description: Turn an important date into a good deed or a small gesture for someone else.

heavenMessage.title: Message from Heaven
heavenMessage.description: A special format for important messages, memories and words that should stay close for years to come.

privacy.title: Your relationships are not content
privacy.description: HappyDate is built around privacy and trust. You decide what to keep and what Happy may use to help you.

points.control: Your data stays under your control
points.context: You decide what Happy can take into account

finalCta.title: Start with what already works today.
finalCta.description: Add an important person, date or memory — and let Happy help you keep what matters from getting lost.
